name: contribution-graph
purpose: Use ContributionGraph for a 52-week × 7-day calendar heatmap of daily activity intensity (platform contributions, deployments, builds, Copilot tasks) across a year. Each day renders as a cell shaded across five sequential intensity levels (0–4), with month and weekday axes, a hover and keyboard-focus readout, an intensity legend, and optional day selection so clicking a cell filters a sibling history list. Unlike `Tracker` (a 1D status strip of discrete severities for uptime) or `Chart` (a continuous time-series plot), `ContributionGraph` reveals weekly and seasonal cadence of daily counts at a glance.
useWhen: User profile platform contributions across a year, paired with a year-over-year selector and a `Timeline` of contribution history.
Daily deployment, build, or AI workflow cadence over a 12-month period where streaks and active days matter.
Any calendar-aligned daily intensity heatmap with up to 366 days where selecting a day filters activity details.
avoidWhen: Uptime or pass/fail severity history across discrete periods → use `tracker`.
A continuous measured trend over time (requests/sec, latency, bandwidth) → use `chart` or `spark-chart`.
Comparing totals across named categories → use `bar-list`.
Picking a single date or date range in a form → use `date-picker` or `date-range-picker`.
related: `tracker` — 1D severity strip for service uptime; `contribution-graph` is a 2D calendar grid of quantitative intensity.
`timeline` — chronological activity feed commonly paired below `contribution-graph` and filtered by its `v-model:selected-date`.
`stat-tile-group` — summary KPI strip placed above `contribution-graph` (total contributions, streaks, deployments).
`card` — the surface `contribution-graph` usually sits inside; the graph itself has no outer card chrome.
bestPractices: Supply ISO date strings (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in `items`; days without an entry render as level `0` (zero activity) so the calendar grid stays continuous.
Pass `year` (e.g. `2026`) when showing a calendar year paired with a year-over-year selector; omit `year` to render the rolling 52 weeks ending at `endDate` (or the latest item date).
Bind `v-model:selected-date` to filter a sibling `Timeline` or list to that day, and provide a visible clear control when a date is selected.
Always supply `ariaLabel` naming the subject and period (e.g. `"Platform contributions in 2026"`).
Don't use it to compare amounts precisely; five intensity steps show a pattern, so put the exact numbers in a table or `StatTile`s next to it.
Don't place it on a `Texture`; it carries `data-plain-ground`.

props.name: items
props.doc: Daily contribution entries (`{ date: string; count: number; level?: ContributionGraphLevel; label?: string }`). Missing days render at level 0.

props.name: year
props.doc: Calendar year to display (Jan 1 – Dec 31). When omitted, displays 52 weeks ending at `endDate` or the latest item date.

props.name: endDate
props.doc: ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) ending a rolling 52-week window when `year` is omitted.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Renders the `Less … More` intensity legend in the footer.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Renders a Skeleton placeholder in place of the calendar grid.

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message; when set, renders an `EmptyState` with the message inside a `role="alert"` region in place of the grid.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the contribution grid.

events.name: select
events.notes: Fires when a day cell is activated by pointer click or Enter/Space.
